title: DERIVED_VARIABLES — Medical History
description: Benign breast disease and diabetes history derived from the baseline questionnaire.

R0_BBD.title: History of benign breast disease.
R0_BBD.x-derivation: Set to 1 if any of the following are present in the BreastDisease section: (a) the direct question on benign breast disease/abnormality is answered 'Yes' (R0_BBD_Abnormality=1); (b) at least one episode is recorded with a type (R0_BBD_Type) or a coded procedure (R0_BBD_ProcedureType); (c) any 'extra' procedure flags indicate biopsy, part/lump removed, whole breast removed, both breasts removed, or other (R0_BBD_Biopsy/Lump/Mastec/BothRem/Other = 1); (d) 'further' or 'more than 4' boxes are ticked (R0_BBD_Further=1 or R0_BBD_MoreThan4=1). Set to 0 if the direct question is 'No' (R0_BBD_Abnormality=2) and no other evidence is present. Otherwise, null.

R0_DiabetesStatus.title: Diabetes diagnosis status at baseline.
R0_DiabetesStatus.x-derivation: Questionnaire self-report of doctor diagnosis prior to R0.

R0_AgeDiabetes.title: Age at diabetes diagnosis (years).
R0_AgeDiabetes.x-derivation: Taken directly from questionnaire variable, otherwise unknown (only retained if R0_DiabetesStatus=1).
R0_AgeDiabetes.$comment: Former name: illnessdiabetesage. Rule R004 applies: -999 unless R0_DiabetesStatus = 1 (D029).

R0_DiabetesInsulin.title: Whether diabetes was treated with insulin at baseline.
R0_DiabetesInsulin.x-derivation: Taken directly from questionnaire variable, otherwise unknown.
